shots.prompt: The phone on the desk vibrates and the screen lights up again and again. Slow push-in. Nobody is in the frame. No music, no text on screen.
He grabs the phone the moment it lights up and types very fast with both thumbs, then taps send with satisfaction. Close, lively camera. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
The phone lights up; she calmly turns it face-down, lifts her teacup and sips slowly. Steady camera. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
During the meeting he keeps stealing glances under the table at the phone, then quickly looks up and nods as if listening. Slow handheld camera. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
He opens the phone, checks, locks it, waits two seconds, opens it again, checks again and lets out a small sigh. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
The phone lights up beside her; she glances at it, smiles a little and turns the page of her book without touching it. Calm camera. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
On the sofa she scrolls slowly through a long list of messages, nodding to herself, sipping tea. Slow push-in. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
She is relaxing, the phone buzzes once, she glances at it and instantly sits bolt upright, eyes wide, and opens it with both hands. Quick push-in. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
She taps the phone once, puts it down with a satisfied little smile and goes back to watching television. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.

Walking on the evening street, he glances at the phone, his face softens into a small relieved smile, and he slips it back into his pocket. Smooth tracking camera. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
She looks up from her phone, smiles warmly at the camera and gives a small nod. Slow push-in. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
